notices: Income Tax Act, 2025 ek April 2026 se lagu. TY 2026-27 se TDS ke form number badle hain: salary ka 24Q ab Form 138, non-salary ka 26Q ab Form 140. Due dates wahi hain.
TCS return ab 15 tarikh ko nahi — TDS ke saath 31 tarikh ko aata hai.
DIR-3 KYC ab har saal nahi. 31 March 2026 se ye teen financial year mein ek baar, 30 June tak file hoti hai. Mobile, email ya address badle toh 30 din mein alag se update.
Non-audit business ki ITR (ITR-3 / ITR-4) ki due date ab 31 August hai. Salary walon ke liye 31 July hi hai.
Small company ki seema 1 December 2025 se badhkar 10 crore paid-up capital aur 100 crore turnover ho gayi hai — isse MGT-7 ya MGT-7A ka chunav badal sakta hai.

items.d: Pichhle mahine ki saari sales ka invoice-wise detail. Ye pehle jaata hai, GSTR-3B baad mein.
items.n: Deri par aapke buyer ka ITC atakta hai — wahi sabse pehle phone karta hai.

items.d: QRMP mein sales ka detail quarter khatam hone ke baad wale mahine ki 13 tarikh tak.
items.n: Beech ke do mahine IFF optional hai — buyer ko ITC jaldi chahiye toh use kar lijiye.

items.d: Quarter ke pehle do mahine ke B2B invoice upload karne ki optional suvidha.
items.n: Optional hai, lekin B2B buyer wale business mein practically zaroori ho jaata hai.

items.d: Mahine ka summary return aur tax payment. Ab ye auto-populated hai aur figures edit nahi hote.
items.n: ITC sirf GSTR-2B mein jo dikh raha hai utna hi milta hai — pehle 2B milaiye, phir file kijiye.

items.d: QRMP ka quarterly summary return. Haryana, Delhi, UP, Punjab, Rajasthan jaise states mein 24 tarikh.
items.n: Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu jaise states ke liye ye date 22 hai. State ke hisaab se confirm kar lijiye.

items.d: QRMP mein return quarterly hai, par tax har mahine 25 tarikh tak challan se jama karna hota hai.
items.n: Return quarterly hone ka matlab payment bhi quarterly nahi — yahi sabse common galatfehmi hai.

items.d: Composition dealer ka quarterly statement aur tax payment.
Composition scheme ka annual return, pichhle financial year ke liye.
Pichhle financial year ka GST annual return.
items.n: Turnover 2 crore tak ho toh ye optional hai, par books se milan phir bhi karna chahiye.

items.d: Annual return aur audited accounts ke beech reconciliation statement. Bade turnover par lagta hai.
items.n: Aam taur par 5 crore se upar ke turnover par. Aapka turnover check karke bata denge.

items.d: Bina IGST diye export karne ke liye har financial year se pehle naya LUT lena hota hai.
items.n: Purana LUT 31 March ko khatam ho jaata hai — naya na liya toh export par tax bharna padega.

items.d: Job worker ko bheja aur wapas aaya maal — iska statement. Sirf job work karne walon par.
items.n: Turnover ke hisaab se ye half-yearly ya annual hota hai. Manufacturing unit ho toh check karwa lijiye.

items.d: Pichhle mahine kaata gaya TDS aur TCS sarkar ke paas jama karna.
items.n: March mein kaata gaya TDS 30 April tak jama hota hai — 7 April nahi. Yahi sabse mehngi galti hai.

items.d: Quarterly TDS statement. Naye Income-tax Rules, 2026 ke tehat salary ka 24Q ab Form 138 hai aur non-salary ka 26Q ab Form 140.
items.n: Form numbers badle hain, dates wahi hain. Non-resident aur TCS ke forms bhi renumber hue hain — file karne se pehle confirm kar lijiye.

items.d: Tax collected at source ka quarterly statement.
items.n: Pehle ye 15 tarikh ko aata tha. Ab TDS ke saath hi 31 tarikh ho gaya hai — purani diary mat dekhiye.

items.d: Har employee ko salary TDS ka certificate.
items.n: Employee iske bina apni ITR nahi bhar paata — deri seedhi shikayat banti hai.

items.d: Non-salary payments par TDS ka certificate, quarterly return file hone ke baad.
Saal ka tax kist mein — 15 June tak 15%, 15 Sept tak 45%, 15 Dec tak 75%, 15 March tak 100%.
items.n: Presumptive scheme (44AD / 44ADA) mein poora tax ek hi baar 15 March tak. Senior citizen ko business income na ho toh chhoot hai.

items.d: Audit report portal par upload — ITR se pehle. Yahi na hone par ITR ki date bhi nikal jaati hai.
items.n: Audit report aur ITR do alag deadline hain. Pehli miss hui toh doosri bachegi nahi.

items.d: Salary, pension, house property, capital gains — jinke paas business income nahi.
Business ya profession wali income, jahan tax audit nahi lagta.
items.n: Ye date ab 31 July se badalkar 31 August ho gayi hai. Salary walon ki date phir bhi 31 July hi hai.

items.d: Jin par tax audit lagta hai unki return.
Company ki return audit ke saath. Audit na lagne wali LLP ke liye date pehle aa jaati hai.
items.n: Nuksaan (loss) carry forward tabhi hoga jab return due date ke andar file ho.

items.d: Trust, society aur Section 8 company ki return.
Trust ya institution ka audit report — ITR se pehle.
items.n: Sahi form chunna zaroori hai. Galat form = audit report file hi nahi maana jaata.

items.d: Saal bhar mein mile donations ka statement, aur donor ko 80G certificate.
items.n: Isme naam na aaya toh donor ka 80G deduction nahi milega.

items.d: Due date nikal gayi ho toh return bharne ki aakhri normal window.
items.n: Late fee ke saath. Iske baad sirf updated return (ITR-U) ka rasta bachta hai.

items.d: Property kharidne par kaata gaya TDS — jis mahine kaata, uske khatam hone ke 30 din ke andar.
items.d2: Property ki value tay seema se upar ho toh buyer par TDS ki zimmedari hai, seller par nahi.
items.n: Builder ko poora paisa de diya aur TDS nahi kaata — ye notice hum har mahine dekhte hain.

items.d: Financial year khatam hone ke 6 mahine ke andar annual general meeting.
items.n: Pehli AGM incorporation ke baad 9 mahine tak ho sakti hai. OPC par AGM lagti hi nahi.

items.d: Audited financial statements ROC ke paas — AGM ke 30 din ke andar.
items.n: Date AGM se judi hai. AGM jaldi hui toh ye bhi jaldi. OPC ke liye FY khatam hone ke 180 din ke andar.

items.d: Annual return — shareholding aur directors ka record. AGM ke 60 din ke andar.
items.n: Small company aur OPC MGT-7A bharti hain. Small company ki limit 1 Dec 2025 se badhkar 10 crore paid-up / 100 crore turnover ho gayi hai.

items.d: Auditor ki niyukti ki soochna — AGM ke 15 din ke andar.
Director aur designated partner ki KYC. Ab har saal nahi — teen financial year mein ek baar, 30 June tak.
items.n: Naya niyam 31 March 2026 se lagu. Cycle DIN allot hone ke saal se chalti hai, aakhri filing se nahi. Mobile, email ya address badle toh 30 din ke andar alag se update karna hoga.

items.d: 31 March tak bakaya loan aur deposit ka return.
items.n: Director se liya unsecured loan bhi isme aata hai — ‘humne toh deposit liya hi nahi’ kehkar chhodne wala form nahi hai.

items.d: MSME supplier ka 45 din se zyada bakaya payment — half-yearly report.
items.n: Ye return aur income tax ka 43B(h) alag-alag cheez hain, par jad ek hi hai — MSME ko der se payment.

items.d: Share capital reconciliation — unlisted public company ke liye half-yearly.
Business shuru karne ki declaration — incorporation ke 180 din ke andar, ek hi baar.
items.d2: Jab tak ye file nahi hoti, company legally business shuru nahi kar sakti.
items.n: Ye chhoot jaaye toh company par 50,000 tak aur har officer par rozana penalty lagti hai.

items.d: Saal mein kam se kam 4 board meetings, do meeting ke beech 120 din se zyada gap nahi.
items.d2: Small company aur OPC ke liye saal mein 2 meetings, aur unke beech kam se kam 90 din ka gap.
items.n: Minutes book ROC inspection aur bank dono maangte hain. Baad mein banaye gaye minutes pakde jaate hain.

items.d: Members, directors, charges aur share transfer ke registers, aur minutes book — hamesha updated.
LLP ka annual return — partners aur contribution ka detail.
items.n: Nil business wali LLP ko bhi ye bharna hai. Late fee rozana chalti hai.

items.d: Statement of accounts and solvency — LLP ka financial statement.
items.n: Turnover 40 lakh ya contribution 25 lakh se upar ho toh audit bhi lagta hai.

items.d: Registration 5 saal ke liye milti hai. Renewal khatam hone se 6 mahine pehle apply karna hota hai.
items.d2: 80G ki renewal bhi isi ke saath chalti hai.
items.n: Date nikal gayi toh registration hi chali jaati hai aur poori exemption khatre mein aa jaati hai. Apni order ki date dekhkar abhi calendar mein daal lijiye.

items.d: FCRA ka annual return — pichhle financial year ke foreign contribution ka hisaab.
items.n: Nil return bhi bharna hota hai.

items.d: State ke Registrar of Societies ke paas annual list of members aur accounts — rajya ke hisaab se.
items.n: Haryana, Delhi aur UP teeno ke niyam alag hain. Apne state ka bata denge.

items.d: Employees ka provident fund challan aur ECR — salary ke agle mahine ki 15 tarikh tak.
items.n: Deri par interest aur damages dono lagte hain, aur ye employer par hi padte hain.

items.d: ESI contribution — PF ke saath hi 15 tarikh tak.
items.n: Contribution jama na ho toh employee ka claim atak jaata hai.

items.d: Jin states mein PT lagta hai wahan salary se katauti aur filing. Har state ki date alag hai.
items.n: Haryana mein PT nahi lagta. Multi-state team ho toh har state alag dekhna padta hai.

items.d: Kuchh states mein half-yearly ya annual contribution.
items.n: Haryana mein ye monthly chalta hai, Delhi mein half-yearly. State ke hisaab se set karwa lijiye.

items.d: Eligible employees ko bonus financial year khatam hone ke 8 mahine ke andar, aur uska return Form D mein.
items.n: Provision books mein banaya par diya nahi — toh income tax mein deduction nahi milta. Ye do alag rules hain.

items.d: Chaar labour codes 21 November 2025 se lagu ho chuke hain — wages ki nayi paribhasha se CTC structure, PF aur gratuity sab badalte hain.
items.d2: Registers, appointment letter aur salary slip ka format bhi inhi ke hisaab se rakhna hota hai.
items.n: Salary structure ek baar theek karwa lena bad mein arrears bharne se sasta padta hai.

items.d: Dukan ya office ka registration aur, jahan lagu ho, uska renewal.
Accounts, bills aur bank record maintain karna aur tay saal tak sambhaal kar rakhna.
items.n: Scrutiny mein sabse pehle yahi maanga jaata hai. Purane saal ka data mil na paana khud mein problem ban jaata hai.

items.d: Address, director, partner ya signatory badalne par record har jagah update karna.
items.n: GST, MCA aur bank — teenon jagah alag-alag update karna padta hai. Ek jagah karke chhod dena hi problem banta hai.
